items.q: Is weed delivery legal in Columbia, MD?

blocks.html: Yes. Following Maryland’s adult-use legalization, licensed services can legally deliver cannabis products to private residences.

items.q: What do I need to show the driver?

blocks.html: You must present a valid government-issued photo ID (such as a driver’s license or passport) that proves you are at least 21 years old.

items.q: How long will my delivery take?

blocks.html: Most orders in the Columbia area are fulfilled within 60 to 90 minutes. We provide updates throughout the process so you know exactly when to expect your driver.

items.q: Are there limits on what I can buy?

blocks.html: Yes. In Maryland, adults can possess up to 1.5 ounces of flower, 12 grams of concentrated cannabis, or products containing up to 750mg of THC.
